plan.title: Cancel Extend Time Keeps End Unchanged

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary instead of creating or searching for an event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the test setup.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where the current bidding end is shown and its Settings menu is available.
Record the current end time E before opening the extension dialog.
Open the Increase Event Time window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Enter the requested custom duration amount.
Set the custom duration unit to Minutes.
Cancel the extension without saving it.
Verify that the Increase Event Time window closes.
Verify that the displayed bidding end time remains E.
